items.source: name - the name of the header
items.translation: name - 标题的名称

items.source: value - the expected value of the header
items.translation: value - 该标头的预期值

items.source: This assertion fails if the header has secondary values.
items.translation: 如果标头具有次要值，此断言将失败。

items.source: Verify that the actual HTTP headers contain a header with the given name and String primary value.
items.translation: 验证实际的 HTTP 头是否包含一个具有给定 `name` 和String 主值`value`的标头。

items.source: Verify that the actual HTTP headers contain a header with the given name and Instant primary value.
items.translation: 验证实际的 HTTP 头是否包含一个具有给定 `name` 和Instant 主值 `value` 的标头。

items.source: Verify that the actual HTTP headers contain a header with the given name and long primary value.
items.translation: 验证实际 HTTP 头是否包含具有给定 `name` 和长主要 `value` 的标头。

items.source: names - the names of expected HTTP headers
items.translation: names - 预期 HTTP 头部的名称

items.source: name - the considered header name (case-insensitive)
items.translation: name - 要检查的标头名称（不区分大小写）

items.source: values - the exhaustive list of expected values
items.translation: values - 预期值的详尽列表

items.source: Verify that the actual HTTP headers contain a header with the given name that satisfies the given valueRequirements.
items.translation: 验证实际 HTTP 头是否包含一个满足给定 `name` 和 `valueRequirements` 的标头。

items.source: Verify that the actual HTTP headers contain a header with the given name.
items.translation: 验证实际 HTTP 头是否包含具有给定name的标头。

items.source: Verify that the actual HTTP headers contain the headers with the given names.
items.translation: 验证实际 HTTP 头是否包含具有给定names的标头。

items.source: Verify that the actual HTTP headers contain only the headers with the given names, in any order and in a case-insensitive manner.
items.translation: 验证实际的 HTTP 头是否仅包含给定 `names` 中的头，顺序不限且区分大小写。

items.source: Verify that the actual HTTP headers do not contain a header with the given name.
items.translation: 验证实际的 HTTP 头不包含具有给定name的标头。

items.source: Verify that the actual HTTP headers do not contain any of the headers with the given names.
items.translation: 验证实际的 HTTP 头不包含任何具有给定 `names` 的标头。

items.source: Verify that the number of actual headers is the same as in the given HttpHeaders.
items.translation: 验证实际标头数量与给定的 HttpHeaders 中的数量相同。

items.source: Verify that there are exactly expected headers present, when considering header names in a case-insensitive manner.
items.translation: 验证在忽略大小写的前提下，是否存在恰好 `expected` 个标题。

items.source:
Verify that the given header has a full list of values exactly equal to
the given list of values, and in the same order.
items.translation: 验证给定的标题是否包含与给定值列表完全相等且顺序相同的完整值列表。

items.source:
Verify that the given header has a full list of values exactly equal to
the given list of values, in any order.
items.translation: 验证给定的标题是否包含与给定值列表完全相同的完整值列表，顺序不限。

items.source: Verify that the actual HTTP headers are empty and no header is present.
items.translation: 验证实际的 HTTP 头是否为空且不存在任何头。

items.source:
Verify that the actual HTTP headers are not empty and at least one header
is present.
items.translation: 验证实际的 HTTP 头不为空，且至少存在一个头。

items.source: other - the HttpHeaders to compare size with
items.translation: other - 要比较大小的 HttpHeaders

items.source: name - the name of an HTTP header that should not be present
items.translation: name - 不应存在的 HTTP 头名称

items.source: names - the names of HTTP headers that should not be present
items.translation: names - 不应存在的 HTTP 头名称

items.source: valueRequirements - the group of assertions to run against the values of the header with the given name
items.translation: valueRequirements - 针对具有给定名称的标头值的断言组

items.source: expected - the expected number of headers
items.translation: expected - 预期的头数量

items.translation: Stephane Nicoll, Simon Baslé
